subject: Non-Zero Detection Probability Estimate for Sites with No Detections

messages.author: 67eefb0e32c64fae
messages.subject: Non-Zero Detection Probability Estimate for Sites with No Detections
parts:
Hi there!

I am running a detection probability analysis for the Eastern Hog-nosed snake. After 2 years of presence-absence surveys, we found a single Hognose at one site in the second year. However, when I plot my site-specific detection probabilities, it gives me non-zero detection probabilities for several other sites. How and why is Unmarked predicting this? 

Shouldn't it be a detection probability of zero if the species was never detected at a site? OR Is it using site-level characteristics from the site with a detection to to predict that Hognose also occur at similar sites?

Graph below... Site 6 is the site with the detection!

Sean Hudson
